batches.name: Stratford and Shelton
batches.why: Eight single-church suburban parishes (Stratford 5, Shelton 3), each its own pastor; no shared pastor or grouping in the directory. Most link ParishesOnline (St. Mark, St. Lawrence, St. Margaret Mary, St. Joseph) or 4LPi (Our Lady of Peace); St. James is eCatholic behind Cloudflare (403; visit.py found ecatholic:19032). Typical batch: start here.

batches.name: Bridgeport: Cathedral, downtown and East Side
batches.why: City centre with merged multi-church parishes. The Cathedral Parish schedules Masses at St. Augustine Cathedral and St. Patrick Church; St. Charles Borromeo schedules Masses 'At St. George campus'. Sts. Cyril & Methodius (Institute of Christ the King, Canon Altiere, Rector) and St. Mary are both given at 79 Church Street in the directory: check whether St. Mary shares a site or bulletin with it. St. Augustine Cathedral is not on GCatholic's list. Check that St. George still has Mass.

batches.name: Bridgeport West End and North End, Fairfield's Assumption and Holy Cross, Holy Family–St. Emery
batches.why: Holy Family–St. Emery (Fairfield) merged into Assumption (Fairfield), St. Ann (Black Rock) and St. Peter (Bridgeport) on 1 November 2025; regular Mass at Holy Family was to end 4 January 2026 (diocesan release, 2025-11-03), and St. Emery was to be erected an oratory (diocesan post, 2025-10-01). Settle Holy Family and St. Emery here from the receiving parishes' bulletins. St. Andrew's site is the GCatholic website of the Our Lady of Good Counsel chapel. Our Lady of Fatima and St. Andrew are the North End parishes.

batches.name: Fairfield (south), Easton, Westport, Weston and Wilton
batches.why: Single-church parishes in the towns west of Bridgeport. St. Anthony of Padua's schedule includes Masses at Fairfield University's Egan Chapel (campus Mass). Weston's St. Francis of Assisi is not on GCatholic's list. Several sites are eCatholic behind Cloudflare (St. Thomas Aquinas, St. Pius X, St. Francis, Assumption Westport); Notre Dame of Easton redirects off-site.

batches.name: Trumbull, Monroe, Newtown and Redding
batches.why: Four Trumbull parishes, Monroe and Newtown, and Redding. Sacred Heart & St. Patrick (Redding) schedules Masses at Sacred Heart Church (Georgetown) and St. Patrick Church (Redding Ridge); the Georgetown Oratory of the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus is given at the same address (30 Church Street) with its own rector and Latin Masses: check whether the oratory and the parish publish one bulletin or two.

batches.name: Danbury and Bethel
batches.why: Danbury city parishes and Bethel. St. Peter schedules Masses at its own campus and the Sacred Heart of Jesus campus. Our Lady of Aparecida (Brazilian, Bethel) lists Masses 'At St. Peter Parish, Danbury', and its pastor Fr. Leonel Medeiros is also administrator of Immaculate Heart of Mary (directory, 2026-11-12): check both for a shared bulletin. IHM's directory website is a Discover Mass page (daily download cap). St. Peter is eCatholic behind Cloudflare (ecatholic:24336).

batches.name: Brookfield, New Fairfield, Sherman and Ridgefield
batches.why: The northern towns. Holy Trinity, Sherman is on GCatholic but not in the diocesan directory: find out whether it is a church of St. Edward the Confessor (New Fairfield) or of another parish, or closed. St. Edward's site is eCatholic behind Cloudflare (ecatholic:2335) and also embeds a ParishesOnline org.

batches.name: Norwalk and Darien
batches.why: Norwalk's six parishes and Darien's two. St. Joseph and St. Ladislaus is one merged parish with Masses at both churches (St. Joseph's include a San Joselito Chapel).

batches.name: Stamford: downtown, Shippan and the East Side
batches.why: Central Stamford. St. Mary schedules Masses at the St. Benedict campus (St. Benedict–Our Lady of Montserrat on GCatholic) and in St. Joseph Chapel. The Basilica of St. John the Evangelist is not on GCatholic's list. Holy Name of Jesus is eCatholic behind Cloudflare (ecatholic:5511).

batches.name: Stamford (north and Glenbrook) and New Canaan
batches.why: The Parish of St. Cecilia–St. Gabriel schedules Masses at both churches; the Haitian quasi-parish Notre Dame du Perpétuel Secours is given at St. Cecilia's address with its own priest moderator (its directory website is a 2016 PDF on an old diocesan host): check whether it is in the parish's bulletin. St. John Fisher Seminary is the diocesan college seminary: check for public Mass.

batches.name: Greenwich
batches.why: Greenwich's parishes. St. Catherine–St. Agnes (Riverside) schedules Masses at St. Catherine's Church and a chapel; GCatholic lists only St. Agnes. St. Timothy Chapel has its own directory entry but links St. Michael the Archangel's site: likely one bulletin with St. Michael.

batches.name: Eastern Catholic churches in Fairfield County
batches.why: Not under the Diocese of Bridgeport: GCatholic places them in the Ukrainian Eparchy of Stamford (Protection of the BVM, Bridgeport; St. Basil Seminary, Stamford), the Melkite Eparchy of Our Lady of the Annunciation in Boston (St. Ann and Mother of God of Tenderness, Danbury), the Maronite Eparchy of St. Maron of Brooklyn (St. Anthony, Danbury) and the Ruthenian Eparchy of Passaic (St. Nicholas, Danbury; St. John the Baptist, Trumbull). Expect other-jurisdiction exclusions unless survey-review rules otherwise.
